title: operad tui.json
description: The terminal app's settings, read from the operad home.

theme.description: The colour theme: auto follows the terminal's light or dark mode; light and dark are the built-in palettes; terminal uses the terminal's own 16 colours; a family name (catppuccin, solarized, tokyo-night, one, rose-pine, github, kanagawa) follows the terminal's mode like auto; a shipped theme name (for example dracula or nord) is fixed; any other name is a theme file themes/<name>.json in the operad home (not the name of a built-in).
